items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's references to 'Chilton's book' and does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Chilton.

ctx.x: So I think that was a pretty funny happening.
In Chilton's book, in writing about Lester, he mentions Boots and he says Sports, but Jimmy said it was Sport and not Sports. Is that it?
Yeah, it was Cousin Sport and Cousin Boots.
